fluff.overview: The Eyrie Defense Force guards the most sensitive intelligence facility in Free Worlds League space: the Eagle Corps headquarters, a hidden bunker beneath a dead volcano on Wendigo, the airless moon of Atreus. The Eagle Corps served as SAFE's special-forces branch, and its protectors are drawn from highly skilled, xenoplanetary-trained soldiers who spend most of their time sealed inside space suits. Operating in standard platoons of twenty-eight, the EDF carries gyroslug rifles paired with ER support lasers, giving each platoon a 360-meter engagement envelope and enough concentrated firepower to give pause to even BattleMech pilots. This firepower comes at a cost. The weight of their armament prohibits anti-BattleMech operations entirely, and the troops must devote significant effort to redeployment between positions rather than engaging on the move. After the dissolution of the Free Worlds League, the Marik-Stewart Commonwealth retained the Eyrie and its defenders, though SAFE itself splintered into competing factions across the successor states.
